en.t: Tokyo must be going mad with the heat by now.

units.source_text: 名人说罢，久久地把嘴张开，迷迷蒙蒙的，仿佛想起了某日酷暑，又好像要追忆遥远的炙热。

en.t: After saying this, the Master kept his mouth open for a long while, dazed and hazy, as if recalling the intense heat of some day long ago, or trying to summon back a far-off scorching heat.
